name: 裂地巨人
subject: An EARTH-SPLITTING GIANT, complete broad stony humanoid, weathered warm-grey rocky skin, dark rust cloth around waist, two heavy arms and two full legs, a short cracked stone hammer in both hands.

name: 熔山領主
subject: A MOLTEN MOUNTAIN LORD, complete heavily plated volcanic humanoid with basalt shoulder crowns, a stern dark stone face, two thick arms and two rootlike stone legs, muted lava-orange chest seams and dark bronze accents.

name: 泥漿怪
subject: A MUD CREATURE, squat lumpy umber-grey mud body with a small moss-green nucleus and dark sleepy eye slits, thick viscous folds, a few dull tan clay flecks. Not a humanoid or cartoon face.

name: 深沼水蛇
subject: A DEEP-SWAMP WATER SNAKE, complete coiled serpent with a long full tapering tail, olive-black scales, pale ochre belly, rusty red side markings and amber eyes, a broad low venomous head.
